thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] stripe.webhooks.delivery.failure rate > 5% for 6m across prod-1. Paging oncall.
incident-bot: severity P1 · possible third-party quota enforcement (Stripe) · initial impact: webhook ack 429/503 causing downstream job failures
Maria G: saw the spike ~ 06:12 UTC, clients posting orders failing to process.
Maria G: small sample of logs:
```
2026-03-15T06:11:58Z webhook worker=webhook-3 stripe_evt=evt_1KXXX status=failed code=429 response="429 Too Many Requests - quota_exceeded"
2026-03-15T06:12:01Z webhook worker=webhook-1 stripe_evt=evt_1KYYY status=failed code=503 response="503 Service Unavailable"
```
Ashwin R: digging into delivery receipts. We're seeing 429s from stripe for webhook posts + header Retry-After present in many responses. Looks like Stripe has applied a backoff / quota on our account.
Ashwin R: checking stripe dashboard... invoice status shows unpaid/latest invoice overdue and a recent billing flag 'invoice_collection' => possible throttle by billing enforcement
Dena K: I opened support ticket with Stripe: ticket# 2026-000331. Contact is sara@stripe.com. Asked for immediate temporary webhook throughput increase.
Dena K: Stripe replied: "We've flagged the account for billing collection and disabled high-rate webhook delivery; we can apply a short-term lift if payment is settled or an escalation occurs." ETA for initial reply 20-30m.
Maria G: impact summary from product logs: ~2.1% of all signup/payment flows failing end-to-end; concentrated on EU region where throughput is higher due to a partner integration. Some merchants report delayed order confirmations.
Jen S: oncall plan: 1) reduce internal retry pressure 2) enable polling fallback for event ingestion 3) contact finance to clear invoice or request grace 4) throttle non-critical webhook consumers
Mike O'Neill: taking on-call handoff. I'll coordinate with infra and finance. @pagerbot acked.
pagerbot: @Mike O'Neill: You have been paged for incident 1842201123. Reply with 'ack' to confirm.
Mike O'Neill: ack
Ashwin R: immediate mitigation steps I'm pushing now:
- set worker concurrency to 1 for webhook consumers:
```
# k8s patch
kubectl set env deploy/webhook-consumers WORKER_CONCURRENCY=1 -n prod
```
- flip env var to enable polling fallback (this will poll stripe events API every 30s instead of solely relying on webhooks):
```
kubectl set env deploy/stripe-sync ENABLE_STRIPE_POLLING=true POLL_INTERVAL=30 -n prod
```
Maria G: this should reduce webhook delivery pressure and let us fetch missed events via polling.
infra-bot: deploy webhook-consumers concurrency patch started (deploy/webhook-consumers) by Ashwin R
infra-bot: deploy completed in 45s · rollout id: rwd-deploy-2026-03-15T06-18
Ashwin R: started backfill job to catch up missed events; running `rwd-admin sync-stripe --since 2026-03-15T05:45Z` in batch mode.
Ashwin R: backfill progress: 0/1200 events processed (2 nodes allocated). I'll stream updates.
Maria G: contacting top-10 affected merchants with temporary workaround instructions (manual retry + web UI sync). Getting a few support DMs already.
Dena K: finance oncall (s-reports/finance) is looped in; they are attempting a card update / settlement to clear the invoice. If cleared, Stripe may lift the throttle quickly.
Dena K: Stripe support replied: "We can provision a temporary webhook throughput increase for 30 minutes if finance confirms payment or we escalate to the account team." Asked for escalation to account team now.
Mike O'Neill: additional mitigation: reduce non-essential events from being sent. Patching event router to drop 'analytics' and 'metrics' webhooks for 1h.
```
# router config change
route: stripe_webhooks
filters:
  - drop_event_types: ["analytics", "metrics"]
```
Jen S: updating status page and sending initial customer advisory: short delayed confirmations for payments in EU / some merchants. No credit card charges lost, retries in place.
Maria G: support note template (short):
"Hi — we're experiencing delayed delivery of Stripe webhooks for some merchants due to a third-party billing throttle. We're using a polling fallback and running a backfill. Expected resolution window: 30-90 minutes. No loss of funds; order confirmation may be delayed."
Ashwin R: backfill progress: 300/1200 processed. Duplicate detection in place. Error rate for new webhook posts dropped to ~1.2% after concurrency & filter changes.
Dena K: finance update: payment attempt succeeded (authorisation via alternate card), Stripe acknowledged receipt of payment at 06:28 UTC and escalated to account team. They applied a temporary throughput lift.
incident-bot: Stripe support message: "Temporary throughput increase applied for 45 minutes. Monitoring for 2 hours. Account team engagement in progress."
Mike O'Neill: monitoring backlog clear. Backfill job now at 1200/1200 processed. Starting manual verification for top-affected merchants.
Maria G: verification: 9/10 top merchants confirmed orders reappear and confirmations sent. One merchant still has missing events — support ticket opened for them.
Jen S: prepare post-incident comms + customer-facing timeline. Assign postmortem to Ashwin R and Maria G. Add finance and product reviewers.
Ashwin R: notes for postmortem: root cause = billing invoice in collection triggered Stripe to throttle webhook delivery (quota enforcement). Contributing: lack of automated billing alerts tied to webhook delivery, no automatic polling fallback enabled per-region.
Mike O'Neill: incident declared resolved at 06:41 UTC — Stripe temporary lift + backfill cleared the backlog. I'll close the pager after handover.
pagerbot: incident 1842201123 marked resolved by Mike O'Neill
Jen S: followups: 1) add billing-health check alert (monitor stripe invoice state + webhook 4xx/5xx spikes) 2) enable polling fallback by default for EU region 3) create runbook for third-party billing enforcement
Maria G: I'll draft the customer-facing note and tag eng-sre for postmortem review.
incident-bot: Post-incident task created: /tasks/INC-1842201123-postmortem assigned to Ashwin R, Maria G, due 2026-03-18
Mike O'Neill: big thanks to everyone. Good work on the rapid mitigation. :thumbsup:
Maria G: closing Slack thread here, moving discussion to postmortem doc and support tickets for the remaining merchant.
